desc: Implement compact dense product-indexed bitset DP with dp0/dp1 lists, snapshots, inline transition, non-empty starts, and descending product scan.
Run the three sample tests with a minimal harness and report PASS/FAIL only.
If any sample fails, switch to a simpler dictionary-based DP approach.
If samples pass, verify key edge cases: k=0 empty exclusion, zeros, overflow-to-zero, unreachable k, single element product > limit.
